pr_title: Fix misalignments between sql based filtering with the entityfilter based filtering
pr_body:
While this is is technically a bugfix, its been misaligned for so long (now painstaking obvious since we have the history vs live logbook case)  that someone might be relying on it being broken in the way its been broken so I'm not sure if we want to consider it a fix to the how we aligned the recorder and logbook filtering or a breaking change and wait until 2022.7 to fix it. 
## Proposed change
<!--
  Describe the big picture of your changes here to communicate to the
  maintainers why we should accept this pull request. If it fixes a bug
  or resolves a feature request, be sure to link to that issue in the
  additional information section.
-->

The sql include/exclude behavior did not match the `entityfilter` behavior when there was a complex list of includes and excludes.  I added a test for every possible combination we had since there are so many combinations that are allowed.  When the history and logbook tests disagreed with the entityfilter tests, I adjusted the test, and added a test to `test_filters_with_entityfilter.py` to verify the sql path aligns with the `entityfilter` path.  

Entity Filters are applied as follows, SQL filtering is now aligned:

1. No includes or excludes - pass all entities
2. Includes, no excludes - only include specified entities
3. Excludes, no includes - only exclude specified entities
4. Both includes and excludes:
   - Include domain and/or glob patterns specified
      - If domain is included, and entity not excluded or match exclude glob pattern, pass
      - If entity matches include glob pattern, and entity does not match any exclude criteria (domain, glob pattern or listed), pass
      - If domain is not included, glob pattern does not match, and entity not included, fail
   - Exclude domain and/or glob patterns specified and include does not list domains or glob patterns
      - If domain is excluded and entity not included, fail
      - If entity matches exclude glob pattern and entity not included, fail
      - If entity does not match any exclude criteria (domain, glob pattern or listed), pass
   - Neither include or exclude specifies domains or glob patterns
      - If entity is included, pass (as # 2 above)
      - If entity include and exclude, the entity exclude is ignored


The problem is case 4a and case 4b are not matching up

- [x] WAS CORRECT: sql matches entityfilter case 1 https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/b97d346df799d1c16e99dfead628d42cd1fc37ad/homeassistant/helpers/entityfilter.py#L207
- [x] WAS CORRECT: sql matches entityfilter case 2 https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/b97d346df799d1c16e99dfead628d42cd1fc37ad/homeassistant/helpers/entityfilter.py#L211
- [x] WAS CORRECT: sql matches entityfilter case 3 https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/b97d346df799d1c16e99dfead628d42cd1fc37ad/homeassistant/helpers/entityfilter.py#L221
- [x] FIXES: sql matches entityfilter case 4a https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/b97d346df799d1c16e99dfead628d42cd1fc37ad/homeassistant/helpers/entityfilter.py#L238
- [x] FIXES: sql matches entityfilter case 4b https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/b97d346df799d1c16e99dfead628d42cd1fc37ad/homeassistant/helpers/entityfilter.py#L263
- [x] WAS CORRECT: sql matches entityfilter case 4c https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/b97d346df799d1c16e99dfead628d42cd1fc37ad/homeassistant/helpers/entityfilter.py#L276

Hey there @home-assistant/core, mind taking a look at this pull request as it has been labeled with an integration (`recorder`) you are listed as a [code owner](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/dev/CODEOWNERS#L844) for? Thanks!

It's actually worse because 4a and 4b have sub branches
And we need to make it bug for bug compatible with https://github.com/home-assistant/core/issues/59080 since we can't fix that issue since otherwise this would be a breaking change

Something isn't rendering right with sqlalchemy.  Its got the `POSTCOMPILE_param_2` in there.

```
[SQL: SELECT states.entity_id, states.state, states.last_changed, states.last_updated, states.attributes, state_attributes.shared_attrs 
FROM (SELECT max(states.state_id) AS max_state_id 
FROM states JOIN (SELECT states.entity_id AS max_entity_id, max(states.last_updated) AS max_last_updated 
FROM states 
WHERE states.last_updated >= ? AND states.last_updated < ? GROUP BY states.entity_id) AS anon_2 ON states.entity_id = anon_2.max_entity_id AND states.last_updated = anon_2.max_last_updated GROUP BY states.entity_id) AS anon_1, states LEFT OUTER JOIN state_attributes ON states.attributes_id = state_attributes.attributes_id 
WHERE states.state_id = anon_1.max_state_id AND states.entity_id NOT LIKE ? AND states.entity_id NOT LIKE ? AND (CAST(states.entity_id AS TEXT) LIKE ? AND NOT (CAST(states.entity_id AS TEXT) IN (__[POSTCOMPILE_param_2]) OR 0 = 1) OR CAST(states.entity_id AS TEXT) NOT LIKE ? AND (0 = 1 AND NOT (CAST(states.entity_id AS TEXT) LIKE ? OR CAST(states.entity_id AS TEXT) IN (__[POSTCOMPILE_param_2]) OR 0 = 1) OR CAST(states.entity_id AS TEXT) IN (__[POSTCOMPILE_param_4])))]
```
Well there are 2 logbook tests and 4 history tests that disagree with the entityfilter tests on how filtering should work.
I doubt anyone relied on them not being aligned. Let's bring it in.

issue_context.title: Logbook nearly empty since 2022.6.0 when there are both include and exclude filters
issue_context.body:
### The problem

Since update 2022.6.0 my logbook is nearly empty.
The live view from the logbook is working fine. For example I have the logbook open and turn on a light, it shows up immediately:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/59510296/171573818-aa714773-8c1d-484e-aa0b-37ba3ca81a73.png)

Sadly the history isn't working in my logbook. If I switch the view inside my dashboard and switch back to my logbook, the history is empty:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/59510296/171574020-e0ac1de7-4ae1-426c-8330-6b3fc1b2ef93.png)

I know, that my recorder only write the changes every 60 seconds into the database. Even after 5 minutes the logbook is empty.
I can't find anything related inside my log file. If you need any additional information, I'm happy to help.

core-2022.6.0

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?
